import json
from qb.pascal import pascal

CASES = [[[1], [[1]]], [[2], [[1], [1, 1]]], [[3], [[1], [1, 1], [1, 2, 1]]], [[4], [[1], [1, 1], [1, 2, 1], [1, 3, 3, 1]]], [[5], [[1], [1, 1], [1, 2, 1], [1, 3, 3, 1], [1, 4, 6, 4, 1]]]]


def check():
    for input_data, expected in CASES:
        got = pascal(*input_data)
        assert json.loads(json.dumps(got, default=list)) == expected, "pascal(%r) returned %r, expected %r" % (input_data, got, expected)
